findings.summary: executeBatch makes redundant O(N) network requests by calling verifyComment sequentially for each comment, which internally fetches all PR comments and remote git refs.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove verifyComment from the batch loop and manually construct the VerificationResult based on the already-verified batch state, or pass cached remote/reply states to verifyComment.

findings.summary: executeBatch ignores verification.reason when a fixed comment fails verification, falling back to a generic 'verification failed' message and losing valuable debug context.
findings.suggested_fix: Change attempt.verifierFeedback to use verification.reason as a fallback instead of the hardcoded string 'verification failed'.

findings.summary: executeBatch duplicates the core logic for posting replies, upserting comments, and handling verification success/failure across the 'no_fix' and 'fixed' branches.
findings.suggested_fix: Extract the comment persistence and github resolution logic into a shared helper method.
